about.title: Our Story
about.subtitle: Reimagining the ritual of daily drinking water in Pakistan.
about.intro: Watlys is a premium mineral water brand designed for those who appreciate purity, reliability, and sustainability.
about.storyText1: Founded with a vision to deliver uncompromised drinking water across Pakistan, Watlys elevates hydration from a routine necessity into a trusted, premium standard.
about.storyText2: Our water is collected from pristine natural aquifers and delivered in sanitized 19-liter containers.
about.sourceText: We operate under strict ecological protection principles, ensuring subterranean springs remain preserved for future generations.
about.missionText: To make pharmaceutical-grade mineral water a dependable, everyday standard for every home, hostel, and office in Pakistan.
